topics.why_in_news: Government highlighted policy push towards electric mobility to reduce pollution, fossil fuel dependence and support sustainable transport transition in India.
prelims_quick_notes: Electric mobility promotes transition from fossil-fuel vehicles to electric vehicles (EVs).
Focus on reducing vehicular emissions and air pollution.
Supports sustainable and low-carbon transport systems.
FAME scheme promotes EV adoption and charging infrastructure.
Battery technology and charging networks are critical components.
Supports energy security by reducing crude oil dependence.
Linked with renewable energy and green transition goals.
Promotes domestic manufacturing under Make in India.
important_facts: FAME = Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles.
Ministry of Heavy Industries implements FAME scheme.
Lithium-ion batteries widely used in EV ecosystem.
Transport sector contributes significantly to greenhouse gas emissions.
EV transition linked with Net-Zero and climate commitments.
exam_relevance: Important for Environment, Economy and Energy Security.
Useful for climate change, sustainable transport and urban pollution topics.
Can be linked with Paris Agreement and renewable energy transition.
prelims_traps: Electric vehicles reduce tailpipe emissions but electricity source also matters.
FAME scheme is implemented by Ministry of Heavy Industries.
EV adoption alone cannot solve urban transport challenges without infrastructure support.

topics.why_in_news: Government highlighted ongoing river rejuvenation initiatives focusing on pollution control, ecological restoration and sustainable water management across major river systems in India.
prelims_quick_notes: River rejuvenation aims to restore ecological health of rivers.
Focus on pollution reduction and wastewater treatment.
Includes afforestation, wetland restoration and biodiversity conservation.
Namami Gange is major river conservation programme.
Promotes sustainable river basin management.
Supports groundwater recharge and ecosystem restoration.
Linked with climate resilience and water security.
Encourages community participation and inter-state coordination.
important_facts: National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) implements Ganga rejuvenation.
River pollution sources include sewage, industrial waste and solid waste.
Wetlands act as natural filters and biodiversity hotspots.
River ecosystems support agriculture, livelihoods and biodiversity.
exam_relevance: Important for Environment, Ecology and Water Resources.
Useful for pollution control, biodiversity and sustainable development topics.
Can be linked with SDGs and climate adaptation.
prelims_traps: River rejuvenation is not limited to cleaning river water alone.
Wetlands are integral part of river ecosystems.
Pollution control requires both infrastructure and governance mechanisms.

topics.why_in_news: Government released Energy Statistics India 2026 highlighting trends in energy production, consumption, renewable capacity and transition towards sustainable energy systems.
prelims_quick_notes: Energy Statistics India provides official energy sector data.
Covers energy production, consumption and installed capacity.
Includes coal, petroleum, natural gas and renewable energy.
Useful for energy planning and policy formulation.
Highlights transition towards non-fossil fuel energy.
Supports climate commitments and energy security goals.
Renewable energy includes solar, wind, hydro and biomass.
Energy efficiency and diversification remain policy priorities.
important_facts: Published by Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
India is among world’s largest energy consumers.
Coal remains major source of electricity generation.
Renewable energy capacity expanding rapidly in India.
Energy transition linked with Net-Zero target by 2070.
exam_relevance: Important for Environment, Economy and Energy Security.
Useful for renewable energy, climate change and infrastructure topics.
Can be linked with Paris Agreement and sustainable development.
prelims_traps: Non-fossil fuel energy and renewable energy are not exactly identical.
Hydropower is classified as renewable energy.
Coal still contributes major share in electricity generation.
